Files · PostgreSQL · Agents

Get your first useful result.

  1. Open a temporary workspace

    Choose “Try without an account” in the Console. Access lasts 24 hours. Sign in with your TiDB Account for an account workspace.

  2. Explore the sales sample

    Choose the US sales sample. The workspace prepares a File System and saves the sample there. Select the self-service or agent path.

  3. Ask a concrete question

    Which state has the most sales? Compare the actual results, then explore the leading state’s products.

  4. Save and continue

    Save your findings as a report. Reopen the file to inspect the result. For agent work, create a Workspace Key with explicit action and resource permissions.

Temporary access expires. Do not treat a temporary workspace as a permanent home for important data. Provider availability and limits are shown in the Console.
